spec.title: Reference-source inventory (clean-room register)
spec.p: _The single committed record of every external source this project studies. Clones and downloads live under the host `/refs/` tree, which is gitignored wholesale — nothing third-party is ever committed. The host clean-room directive (2026-07-07, extended to this workspace 2026-07-09) binds every row: sources are **inspiration-only**; the working method is study → a decisions-only study note under `notes/` → implementation from the note. No line porting, no file-by-file adaptation, no borrowed expression. License and commit pin are recorded **before** any study deeper than LICENSE + README (IGNITION plan, Phase 0 s6)._

list.item: A source may be read only after its row carries a license verdict.
Study notes record *what the source achieves and which decisions we take*, never its text or code shapes.
Implementation sessions open the study note, not the source.
A row's `class` is `inspiration-only` unless the owner explicitly clears something stronger.
Methods described in papers are implementable freely (methods are not copyrightable); their *reference code* stays inspiration-only.
